question: Identify support loss and prediction-only propagation across all four existing controls without changing estimation.
reference_boundary: Exploratory: selected reference and previous five-arm scores were inspected before designing this audit. This run never parses a reference trajectory and never chooses a reference-error window.
point_time: Original integer UINT32 t in ns from exact header; reference=max; preserve point order.
compensation: Unchanged held body gyro, zero declared bias, identity IMU-from-LiDAR, max_gap_s=.05; fixed IMU origin and no acceleration translation. No rejected initialization state is used.
prediction: Internal constant motion: T_pred=I for the first scan, T_last for one previous pose, otherwise T_last * inverse(T_previous) * T_last. Rotations of returned poses are orthonormalized by the existing estimator. No external prediction or solver change.
invariance: All 4x185 returned pose bits and complete registration reports must match the prior frozen capture-disabled controls. The complete gyro-compensated point digest must match as well. Abort and retain partial raw snapshots on any mismatch.
independent_checks: Independent source range filtering and first-point-per-floor-voxel selection, transforms, exhaustive 27-cell nearest matching with strict tie order, canonical native insertion replay with capacity/pruning, and explicit fixed-match J.T W J/-J.T W residual. Native snapshots provide canonical insertion bytes, separately transform-checked. Reuse the already frozen independent helper; this is not another implementation of the estimator or a physical reference.
matrices: Parameters are translation xyz then world rotation xyz about fixed prediction center; fixed matches/weights. Kernel weight is kernel**2/(kernel+distance_squared)**2. Preserve signed eigenvalues of sym(D H D)/sum_w with D=diag(1,1,1,1/r,1/r,1/r), weighted RMS radius r. No inversion, clipping, epsilon radius, damping or state feedback.
prediction_only: Not alignment_eligible, retaining empty_map/insufficient_points labels and zero support; confirm returned pose differs from the existing prediction only within frozen arithmetic tolerances. A zero correction does not imply the motion is physically correct.
reporting: Publish all 740 diagnostic rows, support failures, matrices/spectra, prediction corrections and native raw snapshot hashes. Compare all cases; do not choose a winner, new gate/default, reference subsequence, calibration or accepted initial state.
execution: One process, independent maps, native parallel point compensation; independent Python replay is diagnostic only. No timing or GPU experiment.
limits: Conditional uncalibrated point-to-point fixed-match geometry can be full rank on a plane. It is not GICP/point-to-plane physical observability, covariance, calibrated accuracy or a unique explanation of estimator failure. Reference layout/body/clock mapping and real IMU/LiDAR calibration remain unresolved.
